Welcome to 白い熊 画!
Please take the next few minutes to read through the tutorial and familiarise yourself with 白い熊 画.\n\nTo begin, slide right.
Good luck on your Japanese journey.
Drag the capture window to move it. Drag its bottom-right corner to resize it — the resize area is inside the capture window. Double-tap it to start OCR and recognise the text under it.
If instant mode is on and the capture window is fairly small, OCR starts immediately. This mode is meant for recognising words, not sentences.
If the background of the text you want to recognise is translucent, adjust the image filter: long-press the capture window, then drag left or right. The image filter must be turned on.
Sometimes a kanji is misrecognised but is easy to correct: swipe quickly downward on it to see possible alternative recognitions.
If the correct kanji is not among the alternatives, swipe quickly to the upper left to enter it by hand. Manual correction needs a keyboard with Japanese handwriting input.
To delete an extraneous character, swipe to the upper right. For all text quick actions, the swipe direction may be reversed in instant mode when there is not enough screen space.
Tap and hold any character to copy the recognised text to the clipboard.
Show or hide 白い熊 画, or change its settings, from its notification.
If you can select the text and don\'t need OCR, select it and send it to 白い熊 画 (share, or the text-selection menu) to open the dictionary.
